اقشعررت (form IVq)
# اِقْشَعْرَرْتُ (iqšaʕrartu) /iq.ʃaʕ.rar.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
# اِقْشَعْرَرْتَ (iqšaʕrarta) /iq.ʃaʕ.rar.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
# اِقْشَعْرَرْتِ (iqšaʕrarti) /iq.ʃaʕ.rar.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِقْشَعَرَّ (iqšaʕarra)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
